call_points.text: **Greenfield Timelines:** FY28 commissioning targets for Rajarhat, HSR, Raipur, and Bangalore projects remain unchanged despite FY26 capex slippage.
**Clinic Expansion:** Company plans to double its clinic count, expanding to Kolkata in FY27 alongside further Bangalore additions.
**Domestic Referral Pipeline:** Clinics served as the primary feeder channel to replace international patient volumes with domestic demand across hospital networks.
**Intercompany Cash Flow:** Standalone Q4 other income includes ₹94 Cr dividend received from Cayman operations.
**Reporting Realignment:** Starting FY27, clinic business operations will be merged and reported under the overall hospital segment.

guidance.statement: Annual capex spend of ₹1,000 Cr each in FY28 and FY29.
Committed ₹3,000 Cr of projects over the next two years, part own cash and part borrowing
No meaningful bed additions for the next two to three years
Southwest Bangalore 100-bed hospital to start by end of Q2
UK private payer mix to move from 95% NHS toward about 70% NHS over 4-5 years
Average length of stay to come down to between 3.9 and 4 from 4.3 in Q1

operating_notes.text: Bangalore cluster performs over 100 robotic cardiac surgeries per month.
Occupancy typically operates in the range of 60% to 65%.
Kolkata cluster represents roughly 26% of group revenues.
India clinic network did about 66,000 consultations in Q1FY27, up about 30% YoY, and clinic footfalls are roughly 30% of hospital OPD footfalls.
Cayman insurance is running at about a USD 60 million annualised book, with July renewals seeing 100% acceptance at higher prices.
India clinic business lost about ₹15 Cr in Q1FY27, disclosed in the IR deck.

timeline.summary: Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited will host a conference call to discuss the company’s performance on Tuesday, May 26, 2026 at 3:00 PM IST.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,593.81 Cr, net profit ₹223.99 Cr.
Narayana Hrudayalaya disclosed a ₹4,000 NSE fine for a technical delay in submitting the Q4FY26 shareholding pattern.
Narayana Hrudayalaya held its Q4FY26 earnings call, confirming a ₹3,000 Cr total capex outlay with ₹1,000 Cr annual spend targeted for FY28 and FY29.
Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd. via **Sridhar S., Group Company Secretary**, scheduled a virtual investor meeting with 18 funds/institutions on June 10, 2026, at 12:00 Noon.

Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd. management, via Macquarie Capital Securities (India) Pvt Ltd, scheduled a group investor meeting with Julius Baer, Lion Global, Quantum AMC, and TATA AIG on June 11, 2026, at 04:00 PM (IST) in London.

On its 3 August 2026 Q1FY27 earnings call, Narayana Hrudayalaya said India net margin expanded 400 bps YoY, Cayman insurance losses narrowed to about USD 3.7 million, and it has committed ₹3,000 Cr to projects over the next two years.
Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited will host a conference call to discuss performance on Monday, November 02, 2026 at 3:00 PM IST.
